summary:
All tests passed. Two issues found and fixed:

1. **Schema drift in `app/main.go`** — migration 002 renamed `status` → `order_status`, but the Go code still referenced the old column name `status` in both the INSERT (line 109—was line 107) and SELECT (line 126—was line 129) queries.

2. **Missing PATH in `test.sh`** — PostgreSQL binaries (`initdb`, `pg_ctl`, etc.) are in `/usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin/` which wasn't in the PATH when running `su postgres -c`.
